# Next.js Adapter

`@personaai/adapters` provides complete, seamless integration for Next.js (App Router 14+):
- **Server:** `@personaai/adapters/nextjs/server` maps Next.js Web `Request` and `Response` objects to `@personaai/runtime`.
- **Client:** `@personaai/adapters/nextjs` provides client-side React providers and hooks re-exported directly from `@personaai/react`.

```bash
npm install @personaai/adapters next react
```

---

## 1. Server Route Handler (`@personaai/adapters/nextjs/server`)

Create a catch-all route at `app/api/persona/[...persona]/route.ts`:

```ts
// app/api/persona/[...persona]/route.ts
import{} from '@personaai/adapters/nextjs/server';
import{} from '@clerk/nextjs/server';

export const{} = createPersonaHandler({
  baseUrl: process.env.PERSONA_BASE_URL || 'https://api.persona.hasanraiyan.me',
  credential: process.env.PERSONA_CREDENTIAL!,
  
  // Resolve user identity asynchronously
  resolveUserFrom: async (req: Request) => {
    // Example using Clerk
    const session = await auth();
    return session.userId ?? null;
  },

  // Optional capabilities
  capabilities: {
    agentsWrite: false, // default
  },
});

// Route Segment Options
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
export const runtime = 'nodejs';
```

### Handler API Reference

#### `createPersonaHandler(options)`
Returns an object containing `{ GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, runtime }` conforming to Next.js route handler signatures.

- `baseUrl` *(string, required)*: API host URL.
- `credential` *(string, required)*: Persona Project API key.
- `resolveUserFrom` *(NextResolveUser)*: Async function receiving Web standard `Request`, returning `string | null | Promise<string | null>`.
- `capabilities` *(RuntimeCapabilities, optional)*: Opt-in admin features.
- `hooks` *(RuntimeHooks, optional)*: Async lifecycle listeners.

#### `toNextRouteHandlers(runtime, options?)`
Converts an existing `Runtime` instance into Next.js route handlers:

```ts
import{} from '@personaai/runtime';
import{} from '@personaai/adapters/nextjs/server';

const runtime = createRuntime{});
export const{} = toNextRouteHandlers(runtime, {
  resolveUserFrom: async (req) => extractUserId(req),
});
```

## 2. Authentication Recipes

### With NextAuth / Auth.js v5

```ts
import{} from '@personaai/adapters/nextjs/server';
import{} from '@/auth';

export const{} = createPersonaHandler({
  baseUrl: process.env.PERSONA_BASE_URL!,
  credential: process.env.PERSONA_CREDENTIAL!,
  resolveUserFrom: async () => {
    const session = await auth();
    return session?.user?.id ?? null;
  },
});
```

### With Custom Bearer Token / Header

```ts
export const{} = createPersonaHandler({
  baseUrl: process.env.PERSONA_BASE_URL!,
  credential: process.env.PERSONA_CREDENTIAL!,
  resolveUserFrom: async (req) => {
    const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
    if (!authHeader?.startsWith('Bearer ')) return null;
    
    const token = authHeader.slice(7);
    const userId = await verifyJwtToken(token);
    return userId;
  },
});
```

## 3. Client Integration (`@personaai/adapters/nextjs`)

`@personaai/adapters/nextjs` is marked with `'use client'` and re-exports the complete `@personaai/react` suite.

### Step 1: Wrap Root Layout with `PersonaProvider`

```tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import { PersonaProvider } from '@personaai/adapters/nextjs';

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        <PersonaProvider baseUrl="/api/persona">
          {children}
        </PersonaProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

### Step 2: Use React Hooks in Client Components

```tsx
// app/chat/page.tsx
'use client';

import { useChat, useVoice, useThreads } from '@personaai/adapters/nextjs';

export default function ChatView() {
  const { messages, input, setInput, sendMessage, isStreaming, threadId } = useChat({
    agentId: '68f12a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d',
  });

  const { threads, activeThreadId, selectThread } = useThreads({
    agentId: '68f12a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d',
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen">
      {/* Thread Sidebar */}
      <aside className="w-64 border-r p-4 space-y-2">
        <h2 className="font-bold text-sm">Conversations</h2>
        {threads.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t._id}
            onClick={() => selectThread(t._id)}
            className={`w-full text-left p-2 rounded text-sm ${t._id === activeThreadId ? 'bg-primary text-white' : 'hover:bg-muted'}`}
          >
            {t.title || 'Untitled Chat'}
          </button>
        ))}
      </aside>

      {/* Chat Area */}
      <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col p-4">
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-4">
          {messages.map((m, idx) => (
            <div key={idx} className={m.role === 'user' ? 'text-right' : 'text-left'}>
              <div className="inline-block p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted max-w-xl text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">
                {m.content}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); }} className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
          <input
            value={input}
            onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Type a message..."
            className="flex-1 border p-2 rounded text-sm"
          />
          <button type="submit" disabled={isStreaming} className="bg-primary text-white px-4 py-2 rounded text-sm">
            Send
          </button>
        </form>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Streaming Optimization & Edge Runtimes

- **Streaming:** The server adapter converts the runtimeâ€™s async event stream into a standard Web `ReadableStream`, using UTF-8 `TextEncoder` with backpressure.
- **Node.js Runtime Recommended:** Set `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` on the catch-all route file for optimal compatibility with Node.js crypto, encryption, and multipart file upload handling.
